items.prompt: After ingesting n values, the centered sum of squares is M2. Which spread enters this task definition?

options.why: That is the sample denominator and is undefined at 1; the task uses population spread.

options.text: M2/n for the current ingested prefix.
options.why: The declared population variance divides by n, with zero variance for the first observation.

options.text: M2*n because the sample is self-inclusive.
options.why: Self-inclusion changes which observations enter, not this population denominator.
That is not the standard deviation of the n-value population.
